task:
A levy charges 13% on the first 3000 credits of a 5277-credit bill and 49% on the remainder. Subtract a 6-credit rebate from the levy (floor at zero), then apply a 7% surcharge to that reduced levy. What is the exact final levy? No rounding. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:

Adjustment 18: apply a 10% surcharge, then subtract 18 credits.
